title: Criteria for Installing Elevators for Overhead Pedestrian Bridges and Within Train Stations
what_it_is: Criteria for Installing Elevators for Overhead Pedestrian Bridges and Within Train Stations

sections.label: Elevator criteria and priorities
sections.summary: The Minister states criteria for installing elevators at overhead bridges and train stations, with priority for certain locations and elderly neighbourhoods.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Transport (a) what are the criteria for installing elevators for (i) overhead pedestrian bridges and (ii) within train stations to street level; and (b) whether elevators at such locations can be installed for neighbourhoods which have a higher percentage of elderly residents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: This means that, among other things, they will have to provide lifts from the platforms to street level.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: As for providing elevators at overhead bridges, LTA is giving priority to those bridges that are near MRT stations, bus interchanges, healthcare institutions, welfare homes, homes for the aged and special needs schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: LTA will also prioritise those located in neighbourhoods with a higher percentage of elderly residents.

sections.label: First-mile-last-mile connectivity programme
sections.summary: The speaker groups efforts under the first-mile-last-mile connectivity programme, a top priority for a car-lite strategy and top-class public transport.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: It would be good if there is a full package that could be studied and implemented for these neighbourhoods.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I group all these efforts under the first-mile-last-mile connectivity programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: This is one of my top priorities for the next couple of years because, if we want to push our car-lite strategy, our public transport must be top-class.

sections.label: Priorities and funding constraints
sections.summary: The speaker says first-mile-last-mile connectivity is a priority but priorities must be set and the programme depends on funds from the Minister for Finance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The issue is this: first-mile-last-mile connectivity is definitely my priority.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: At the same time, there are so many overhead bridges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I have to set priorities and the programme is also subject to availability of funds that I hope I can get from a sympathetic Minister for Finance.

sections.label: Compact public estates
sections.summary: Public estates are more compact, so the number of people affected would be a lot bigger.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Public estates are more compact and, so, the number of people affected would be a lot bigger.
